pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with rounded vertices and smooth pixel gradients at the edges. The spatial area of individual patches is greatest on the lateral torso, significantly decreasing in scale toward the cervical region.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous topological graph of light pelage with distinct tri-radial junction nodes. Pixel thickness of these pathways is relatively consistent across the mid-section of the torso.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette along the visible upper cervical and dorsal ridge.
